components.text:
Circle: medium circle, infernal chalk.

A witch-type performer brings the one skill the one on the circle has chosen to mastery, on a full-moon night. This one masters Unique skills.
Choose the skill on the Skills page of the hub. Some skills are refused: those an addon rewrites by itself, and those a pack has retired.
By default costs 750,000 base Max EP, spent once it is mastered, and 5 nether stars and 5 netherite ingots. One rite per player every 7 days.
